Hero_Desc_Skea:
Skea, the first High Priest, who slept through long ages according to the World Tree's will.
Even now, she silently fulfills the ancient promise of her vow of silence.
Behind her unreadable exterior lies the thoughtful heart of a senior who wishes to extend a warm, helping hand.
Album_Hate_Skea: People who tease her for being unable to answer
Album_Hobby_Skea: Watching others grow frustrated by her vow of silence
Album_Wish_Skea: To break her vow of silence
Album_Skea1: While walking through the Order, I often encounter Skea dozing against a corner of the corridor. Judging by the snack crumbs scattered around her, she appears to have fallen asleep from a blood sugar crash.
Album_Skea2: When she has much to say but cannot open her mouth because of her vow of silence, Skea often frowns deeply and gestures that she wants to sleep. Perhaps she intends to say everything in her dreams.
Album_Skea3: Skea enjoys watching others happily eat the snacks she shares. Sometimes she stares until they swallow every bite. Her gaze can be so burdensome that some Apostles choke while eating.
Album_Skea4: Skea likes helping others, but also enjoys imagining the praise she will receive before offering that help. Perhaps that is why she often smiles brightly before she has done anything at all.
Album_Skea5: Skea enjoys praise for completing work quickly. She often murmurs proudly in her sleep, 'It is already finished...' Apparently, she frequently dreams of being praised.
Album_Skea6: She cannot tolerate an empty personal snack basket. Skea refills it regularly, though she sometimes overspends through impulsive purchases.
Album_Skea7: While passing through the corridor, I sometimes find Skea standing perfectly still and staring somewhere. Following her gaze reveals that she is watching her juniors, apparently thinking how adorable they are. Interrupting would embarrass her, so I should pretend not to notice and continue on my way.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Hate1: Saying she would try to respect the tastes of Apostles who enjoy such food, she stared at it seriously for quite some time.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Hate2: She pinched her nose and called it an unbelievable combination. Could she perhaps smell pine needles?
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like1: She finished every last bite and seemed delighted by how many strange and mysterious things the world contained.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like10: She found it intriguing, saying that the occasional tartness within its sweetness tasted like a ray of light awakening the mind.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like2: She happily packed it to take away, saying that drinking one bottle before bed seemed pleasant.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like3: With a pure smile, she said the small, round rice cakes were as adorable as the young Apostles running energetically around the Order.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like4: After taking a bite, she was delighted that it tasted exactly as expected. I believe I even heard a faint, happy hum.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like5: Calling it a flavor that snapped her fully awake, she consumed it all in one breath. She wondered whether any food existed that was even more tart.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like6: She said it was truly delicious and wanted several more wrapped up to share with her juniors.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like7: After one bite, she smiled gently at the novel crunch of the almonds.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like8: Skea was delighted, saying this would let her complete her work swiftly.
Food_ChefNote_Skea_Like9: She stuffed several into her mouth at once until both cheeks nearly burst. Skea merely smiled in silence and continued her vow until every candy had dissolved.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Skea: Is this place through which I walk a dream, or reality...?
Skea_Defeat2: Have I not fully awakened yet?!
Skea_Affinity2: Sometimes I wonder whether I might still be dreaming even now.
Skea_Affinity3: It is delightful to awaken from a long dream and see how the kingdom has changed.
Skea_Affinity4: This dish has such a curious flavor. It is not sweet, yet it is. It is truly delicious.
Skea_Affinity5: At times, I find it a little difficult to adjust to how the Order has changed lately. Still, I must do my best.
Skea_Affinity6: When I see Joanne and Ner leading the Order so admirably, how shall I put it... I feel happy, yet a little empty as well.
Skea_Affinity7: Master, you reached out to me when I was suffering most. I shall always be grateful to you.
Skea_LevelUp: Yes, this is the fruit of my training.
Skea_Equipment: They have things like this nowadays?
Skea_HeroSkill: Mmm~ There was a method like this too.
Skea_Board: Do we go that way? Oh dear, my legs.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Skea_Skin1: Skea participates in a Monatium tour package and experiences the mysterious traditions of a foreign land.
Skea_Growth2_Skin1: This truly is a peculiar yet fascinating world.
Skea_LevelUp_Skin1: May I experience something else now?
Skea_Equipment_Skin1: Do clothes like these suit me as well?
Skea_HeroSkill_Skin1: Ah~ How mysterious. It is novel and thrilling!
Skea_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I wish to learn and experience even more.
Skea_Board_Skin1: I would like to see over there too...!
Skea_Touch1_1_Skin1: Could you teach me a little more gently?
Skea_Touch1_2_Skin1: Did I make some mistake...? These new customs are difficult.
Skea_Touch2_1_Skin1: Ah~ What joy. This feels wonderful.
Aside_Get_Skea1: May it become a ray of light that guides those who have lost their way.
Aside_Upgrade_Skea1: May it shine ever brighter and illuminate the road ahead for all.
Skea_AsideGet: May it become a ray of light that guides those who have lost their way.
Skea_AsideUpgrade: May it shine ever brighter and illuminate the road ahead for all.
Skea_Birthday: This humble priest wishes you a happy birthday, Master. May you remain hale and strong.
Skea_Gacha2: Is this place through which I walk a dream, or reality?
LoveLetter_Skea:
I trust you have been well, Master.

I leave these words to thank you for accompanying us on a journey with no promised end. Though I always tell you how grateful I am, each day I feel that those words remain insufficient.

Just as you willingly walked an arduous path for us ancient priests, I too shall strive to be of the greatest possible aid to you. Whatever your will may be, I shall follow it.

From this day onward as well.
LoveCall_Skea:
Hmm... Is this how one uses it...? Ah, hello, Master.
This device is new to me, so my inexperience caused a small mistake. This is scarcely different from talking to myself... Surely it does not break my vow of silence.

Master, you labor for the Order and this world...
I do not know whether I am serving you properly.
You say that I provide great assistance... Yet my heart aches whenever I see you collapse into sleep from exhaustion each day.

I hope the day comes when I have adapted more quickly to the Order and this new world and can truly support you.
Until that day... I will remain beside you and continue to serve.

To turn it off... Ah, is it this button?
Affinity_Skea_EP01_001: Perhaps because I slept for so long, my body remains stiff and sore.
Affinity_Skea_EP01_003: D-dance?! Joanne dances?! Where? Where is she? I must witness it with my own eyes at once!
Affinity_Skea_EP01_005: Exercise... I am not particularly accustomed to it, but if you join me, Master, it may be worth attempting.
Affinity_Skea_EP01_006: Wait and it should improve on its own.
Affinity_Skea_EP01_007: ...Will it? My apologies. I behaved presumptuously and depended upon you, Master.
Affinity_Skea_EP02_001: The Sprite Kingdom... changed greatly while I slept.
Affinity_Skea_EP02_002: I shall guide you. Let us look around together next time.
Affinity_Skea_EP02_003: Nothing could be better than your guidance, Master. Then I shall tell you stories of the old Sprite Kingdom that even you do not know.
Affinity_Skea_EP02_004: Has it truly changed that much?
Affinity_Skea_EP02_005: Yes. The greatest difference of all... must be you, Master. I can see that your presence has changed the kingdom for the better.
Affinity_Skea_EP02_006: Yes. Be certain to learn much from your juniors.
Affinity_Skea_EP02_007: Hmm... Yes, of course. E-even my juniors... surely possess qualities from which I can learn.
Affinity_Skea_EP03_001: Since awakening, I have found my appetite difficult to control. Do you also think I eat too much, Master...?
Affinity_Skea_EP03_002: You may indeed need to eat a little less.
Affinity_Skea_EP03_003: Ghk...! If even you say so, Master... I, Skea, shall undertake a vow of fasting to accompany my vow of silence!
Affinity_Skea_EP03_004: It is natural to be hungry after sleeping for so long. You need to eat well to regain your strength.
Affinity_Skea_EP03_005: Master...! I understand your will. I shall ignore such trifles and devote myself wholeheartedly to the Order!
Affinity_Skea_EP03_006: Is that not merely the average amount for a Sprite?
Affinity_Skea_EP03_007: Hmm, perhaps... Yet as a priest of the Order, I question whether maintaining such a diet is desirable.
Affinity_Skea_EP04_001: To think Ner became High Priest while I slept. It feels rather strange.
Affinity_Skea_EP04_002: What do you think? Does she seem to perform better than you did?
Affinity_Skea_EP04_003: Hmm... Aside from occasionally coveting food excessively, postponing her work, and becoming violent... I believe she is doing well.
Affinity_Skea_EP04_004: Ner does well because you provided a model for her.
Affinity_Skea_EP04_005: ...Thank you, Master. So that I never lose that model... I shall serve you forever.
Affinity_Skea_EP04_006: Do you not wish to become High Priest again?
Affinity_Skea_EP04_007: I have never considered it. My calling now is to adapt to the Order and kingdom of this age and support you and my juniors.
Affinity_Skea_EP05_001: I heard Joanne once rebelled against you, Master... What do you think of that?
Affinity_Skea_EP05_003: ...Yes. Now that the whole truth is known, what matters is not assigning blame and punishing someone... but accepting what happened and moving forward.
Affinity_Skea_EP05_004: Why ask so suddenly? Are you afraid Joanne will do it again?
Affinity_Skea_EP05_005: Certainly not. I merely feel guilty that I could not remain beside you and Joanne at the time.
Affinity_Skea_EP05_006: Even after what happened, I trust Joanne. You do too, correct?
Affinity_Skea_EP05_007: Of course. ...Thank you for trusting Joanne, Master. I too shall trust and follow you forever.
Affinity_Skea_EP06_001: It pains me that my vow of silence seems to frustrate some Apostles.
Affinity_Skea_EP06_003: ...I was prepared for communication to become difficult. Thank you for your concern, Master.
Affinity_Skea_EP06_004: You need not break your vow. You can communicate through me.
Affinity_Skea_EP06_005: Thank you for your consideration. Someday... when your will spreads across the world and achieves peace, I wish to cry out your honored name.
Affinity_Skea_EP06_006: Could you not communicate in writing?
Affinity_Skea_EP06_007: I-it is not so simple. I did not make this vow lightly.
Affinity_Skea_EP07_001: The sugarcane Kyarot grows is of excellent quality.
Affinity_Skea_EP07_002: It seems you enjoy sweets like the other Sprites.
Affinity_Skea_EP07_003: Hmm... I cannot deny it. I have already eaten quite a few macarons from Ner...
Affinity_Skea_EP07_004: Did you like them? Shall I reserve a few for you next time?
Affinity_Skea_EP07_005: Hehe, no. Please care for the Apostles and residents before me. If any remain... then I shall accept your offer.
Affinity_Skea_EP07_007: T-taking it? We merely engaged in necessary fellowship as fellow priests!
Affinity_Skea_EP09_001: To learn the Order's work again as its most junior priest... leaves a somewhat bitter taste.
Affinity_Skea_EP09_002: It cannot be helped. Try to learn well.
Affinity_Skea_EP09_004: Still, Joanne and Ner teach you well, correct?
Affinity_Skea_EP09_005: They teach me very well... which makes it even more bewildering. I never imagined receiving instruction from juniors who once followed me...
Affinity_Skea_EP09_006: You were once High Priest, so it is natural to feel that way.
Affinity_Skea_EP09_007: As expected, you understand my heart. I feel ashamed of having been displeased.
Affinity_Skea_EP10_001: Your cooking is delicious, Master... I wish to ask for more, but I cannot impose upon you any further...
Affinity_Skea_EP10_003: Ah...! Master, did you perceive my heart...? Though embarrassed, I shall gratefully enjoy it.
Affinity_Skea_EP10_005: Is it time to clean up the Banquet Hall? It cannot be helped. You must be busy too, Master, so I shall be satisfied for today.
Affinity_Skea_EP10_007: Yes, asking for more would be mere greed. I must not trouble the Master with needless desire.
Affinity_Skea_EP11_001: Hah! Haaah! Nom nom nom nom!
Affinity_Skea_EP11_005: Mmm! Mmm... Ugh! Gah! Cough, cough!!!!
Affinity_Skea_EP11_006: Pour her water without a word.
Affinity_Skea_EP12_001: Ner is far more considerate and gentle than I expected.
Affinity_Skea_EP12_003: Could that be so? Everything was so chaotic then that I doubt I taught her properly... I can only be grateful.
Affinity_Skea_EP12_004: Yes. She only appears frightening. Her heart is gentle.
Affinity_Skea_EP12_005: Exactly. Everyone fears Ner, but once one knows her, she is remarkably tender and kind.
Affinity_Skea_EP12_006: Do not be deceived by that kindness...
Affinity_Skea_EP12_007: Y-yes? D-did something happen, Master? Your face has gone pale!
Affinity_Skea_EP13_001: I visited the settlement of a race called Elves.
Affinity_Skea_EP13_003: Yes. It contained so many fascinating things that exploring was a delight.
Affinity_Skea_EP13_005: What? Me? With an Elf? Why did you think I had fought them?
Affinity_Skea_EP13_007: Hmm... The Order's most junior priest has more duties than I expected. Still, the errand allowed me to see many fine things.
Affinity_Skea_EP14_001: Have you ever awakened to discover the world changed, Master?
Affinity_Skea_EP14_002: You are not the only one.
Affinity_Skea_EP14_003: ...Ah. That is true. The Elves... and you as well, Master... My thoughts were shallow.
Affinity_Skea_EP14_004: Sometimes I feel something similar after awakening from a particularly deep sleep.
Affinity_Skea_EP14_005: Do you? The world truly changed greatly while I slept... but it is not bad. I believe it may be better, especially with you here, Master.
Affinity_Skea_EP14_006: It was not after sleeping, but I have experienced something similar.
Affinity_Skea_EP14_007: ...M-my apologies... You too were suddenly brought to this world, Master... I failed to consider that...
Affinity_Skea_EP15_001: Yawn... Perhaps the pleasant weather makes me sleepy.
Affinity_Skea_EP15_002: You slept for so long, yet you are sleepy again?
Affinity_Skea_EP15_003: What do you mean, 'so long'...? I did not sleep then because I was tired. How cruel.
Affinity_Skea_EP15_004: Perhaps I should... close for today too...
Affinity_Skea_EP15_005: You must not. Please observe the business hours for the Apostles' sake.
Affinity_Skea_EP15_006: A light nap is best at times like this.
Affinity_Skea_EP15_007: Th-that is true, is it not? A short nap should improve my efficiency... Then I shall sleep only a little.
Affinity_Skea_EP16_001: Uuugh... Did the Order always have this much work...?
Affinity_Skea_EP16_003: You must not say such a thing. High Priest Ner will scold us both when she returns... Let us work diligently.
Affinity_Skea_EP16_004: Was it not like this before?
Affinity_Skea_EP16_005: Hmm... It was so long ago that my memory is hazy. Still, I do not believe it was quite this severe...
Affinity_Skea_EP16_006: Even so, the Order runs well thanks to all of you.
Affinity_Skea_EP16_007: Hehe, thank you. Your words restore my strength, Master. Shall we resume our work?
Affinity_Skea_EP17_001: The Elves know many fascinating foods... I wish to try something called fried chicken.
Affinity_Skea_EP17_002: Very well. I shall cook it for you.
Affinity_Skea_EP17_003: T-truly?! I am not dreaming now, am I? Ah, this is wonderful. Thank you, Master!
Affinity_Skea_EP17_004: Monatium sells blocks that taste similar to fried chicken.
Affinity_Skea_EP17_005: ...Texture is also an essential quality of food.
Affinity_Skea_EP17_006: Fried chicken is not sweet. Is that all right?
Affinity_Skea_EP17_007: Is that so? Now I wonder what can taste delicious without being sweet.
Affinity_Skea_EP18_003: Indeed. It seemed to be a ghost wearing a strange mask and her friend... How vexing. I nearly forgot my discipline and became angry.
Affinity_Skea_EP18_004: That is a trait of their race. Try to understand.
Affinity_Skea_EP18_005: Whew... Truly, what a vexing race. To remain unchanged after so much time... All beings ought to develop!
Affinity_Skea_EP18_006: Who was it? I shall pinch their cheeks!
Affinity_Skea_EP18_007: The masked... Ah, no. I cannot tell tales. Your words alone are enough. Thank you, Master.
Affinity_Skea_EP19_001: Sitting in Kyarot's garden fills me with peace.
Affinity_Skea_EP19_002: While you are there, keep watch for sugarcane thieves.
Affinity_Skea_EP19_003: Must I work when I went there to rest...? The Order's work has been more difficult than expected lately. I wish to rest...
Affinity_Skea_EP19_005: Coffee...? Kyarot served me some... Its flavor was peculiar. Is it medicinal broth? If so, what does it treat?
Affinity_Skea_EP19_007: Indeed. After wandering through dreams for so long... that peaceful time felt even more precious.
Affinity_Skea_EP20_001: I hope the other priests awaken soon. Ah, I am not rushing you!
Affinity_Skea_EP20_002: You mean I should hurry and work...?
Affinity_Skea_EP20_003: N-no...! I had no such intention... M-Master? Why are you laughing...? Did you tease me? How cruel!
Affinity_Skea_EP20_004: Can you not use dreams to visit your friends?
Affinity_Skea_EP20_005: Hmm... Because it is dangerous, High Priest Ner forbade it. A pity.
Affinity_Skea_EP20_006: I understand that you miss your friends. It is all right.
Affinity_Skea_EP20_007: Master... Thank you for comforting me. You must miss your friends too, yet you still comfort me... How vast is your heart...!
